propositions: A PreToolUse hook on the Bash tool must detect grep-family invocations (grep, rg, egrep, fgrep) via simple string matching in the command and emit a short JSON-formatted reminder surfacing Serena's symbol tools as the preferred alternative for reference resolution.

The reminder message must be 2–3 lines, name both find_referencing_symbols and the legitimate grep use cases (string literals, line numbers), and be delivered via hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext without emitting permissionDecision, ensuring the hook is informative and non-blocking.

The hook implementation must live in scripts/hooks/serena_grep_reminder.py (testable, tracked script) and be registered in .claude/settings.json, merging with existing hooks configuration (preserving env.ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH from story C) rather than overwriting it.
The hook must never block execution (no exit code 2, no permissionDecision), must survive malformed input (empty stdin, absent command, non-JSON), and must leave grep output unchanged.
